notes: The key art fills the whole window now, sharp, top to bottom. It was reaching only part of the way down with a blurred copy taking over below it, which is why the lower half looked soft, and the ink over that lower half ran heavy enough that the artwork was technically present and effectively invisible. The picture is still never stretched to fit: a 1920 by 1080 backdrop is tall enough to cover a window of this shape while being made smaller, so it does, while a 1900 by 400 banner is drawn as a band at its own true height with the blur filling the rest.
